query:
SELECT COUNT(*) as total, 
  SUM(CASE WHEN category = 'عربية' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as arabic_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN category = 'SE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as swedish_count
FROM rssSources WHERE isActive = 1;
